_comment: FLOW agent with one ConnectorTool that delegates NLQ->DSL generation to the agent server. Register with POST /_plugins/_ml/agents/_register; type 'flow' selects MLAgentType.FLOW.
name: Agentic Search Remote DSL Agent
description: Single-tool FLOW agent that generates OpenSearch DSL via a connector to the agent server.
_comment_tools: A single-tool FLOW agent returns the tool's output directly. connector_id is the connector registered from 01_connector.json. connector_action selects which connector action runs ('predict' here, matching that connector's action_type).

tools.name: remote_agentic_search
tools.description: Generates OpenSearch DSL from a natural-language question by calling the agent server.
